functions.name: GetCatalogCategories
functions.description: Retrieves the list of all categories available in the catalog.

outputParameters.name: categories
outputParameters.description: An array of catalog category objects or names representing all available categories.

functions.name: Demo_Flow_SearchProducts_Delete
functions.description: Deletes products returned from a demo search flow, typically used for testing or cleanup of demo search results.

functions.name: SearchProducts
functions.description: Searches for products using text query and optional filters such as price range, category, brand, tags, and pagination/sorting options.

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Maximum number of products to return in a single response.

inputParameters.name: q
inputParameters.description: Free-text search query used to match products by name, description, or other searchable fields.

inputParameters.name: summary
inputParameters.description: If true, returns a summarized product list (e.g., fewer fields or aggregated info); if false, returns full product details.

outputParameters.name: products
outputParameters.description: Array of products that match the search query and filters, including their details or summaries depending on the 'summary' flag.

functions.name: GetCategoryProducts
functions.description: Retrieves a list of products for a given category or subcategory, with optional pagination, sorting, and summary-level control.

inputParameters.name: category
inputParameters.description: the category id to search for products in the catalog

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: The maximum number of products to return in this request.

inputParameters.name: offset
inputParameters.description: The zero-based index of the first product to return, used for pagination.

inputParameters.name: sort
inputParameters.description: Sorting criteria for the product list, such as a field name and direction (e.g., 'price_asc', 'price_desc', 'name_asc').

inputParameters.name: subcategory
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the subcategory whose products should be retrieved.

inputParameters.name: summary
inputParameters.description: If true, returns a summarized view of each product (e.g., key fields only); if false, returns full product details.

outputParameters.name: products
outputParameters.description: Array of products that match the search query and filters, including their details or summaries depending on the 'summary' flag.
